basic_info.description:
Walk out your front door to all that Lower Pacific Heights offers! 1701 Baker has the combination that most urban dwellers seek: a classic Victorian on a handsome block, remodeled en suite master plus tub, recently added second bathroom with marble floors, second bedroom, formal dining room, exclusive use outdoor space, independent parking, central heating, stainless steel appliances & fantastic location. Between California & Pine, 1701 sits close to Pac Heights, Presidio, Laurel Village shopping, & Fillmore st. The condo boasts a sensible floor plan: the spacious kitchen sits at the back opening to a private & deeded wrap around deck. New in-building washer dryer steps away and only shared with adjoining unit. Exclusive parking spot in attached garage available. There's a formal dining room w/ fireplace off the kitchen. Both bedrooms are situated away from the street. Living room also has a fireplace. Period detail, parquet floors, & 12 foot ceilings throughout!

Renter responsible for water, gas and electric. Last month's rent due at signing. No smoking allowed. Small animals allowed. Exclusive parking spot in attached garage available for an additional $250/month.
